'''Protocol Boi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] dancer who competed in competitions during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Protocol Boi appears in the [[2012]] Xbox-exclusive [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]'', in the "Galactic Dance-Off" portion.
